findings.title: Missing Secret shop-stage/shop-registry-cred referenced by 1 pod(s)
findings.summary: 1 pod(s) cannot start because Secret "shop-registry-cred" does not exist in shop-stage (image pull secret).
evidence: Secret shop-stage/shop-registry-cred: absent (the secret list was collected successfully)
referenced via image pull secret by: elasticsearch1-0
FailedToRetrieveImagePullSecret x32 on elasticsearch1-0: Unable to retrieve some image pull secrets (shop-registry-cred); attempting to pull the image may not succeed.

steps.description: Confirm it is absent and see which pods need it
steps.command: kubectl get secret shop-registry-cred -n shop-stage -o name

steps.description: Recreate Secret "shop-registry-cred" through its normal provisioning path (operator, pipeline or secret sync), or remove the stale reference from the workload

verify: kubectl get secret shop-registry-cred -n shop-stage -o name
kubectl get events -n shop-stage --field-selector type=Warning | grep shop-registry-cred   # should stop growing

findings.title: Deployment shop-stage/web: 1/1 pods unavailable (ReadinessProbe)
findings.summary: Every pod of deployment web is down. Dominant reason: readiness probe failing (the pod runs but receives no traffic).
evidence: web-69d45cd5c9-jktk8 [ReadinessProbe, node ip-10-0-1-5]: x11: Readiness probe failed: HTTP probe failed with statuscode: 502

steps.description: See what the probe gets back (5xx usually means the app's own upstream is down)
Check backends in the namespace: empty endpoints mean a dependency is down

verify: kubectl get pods -n shop-stage | grep web

findings.title: StatefulSet shop-stage/elasticsearch1: 1/1 pods unavailable (ImagePull)
findings.summary: Every pod of statefulset elasticsearch1 is down. Dominant reason: images cannot be pulled.
evidence: elasticsearch1-0 [ImagePull, node ip-10-0-1-9]: container elasticsearch cannot pull artifactory.example.com/es:7.17: Back-off pulling image "artifactory.example.com/es:7.17"

steps.description: Read the exact pull error (not found, unauthorized, or timeout)
If unauthorized, check the pull secret findings for this namespace
